title: FormatConfig
description: config/formats/<format>/format.yaml: how a format is described to the outside world.

genre.description: IPTC Genre qcode (packages/schemas/iptc/genre.json); not retired. Opinion items add genre:Opinion.

ninjs_type.description: ninjs `type` of a publication in this format.

run_tokens.description: Most tokens (input plus output, over all its model calls) one agent run on this format may use; a run that reaches it ends and its publications are held (D76).

grace.description: How late past its slot a send may still start (30m, 2h); later, the publication is held as a missed slot for an editor (D129).
